notes: Two distinct product lines with different RTSP formats. Speco Blue IP cameras use /profile1 (main) and /profile2 (sub) on port 9008. ONSIP sub-line uses /StdCh<N> (N=1,2,3) on port 554. The /profile2 lead (port 9008) in the strix candidates is confirmed; /ch01/0 and /ch01/1 on port 9008 are NOT documented — they may be cross-brand contamination. URL format: rtsp://{ip}:{port}/{path}
